sloka: तथैव मत्ता मदिरोत्कटा नरास्तथैव दिव्यागुरुचन्दनोक्षिता: ।तथैव दिव्या विविधा: स्रगुत्तमा: पृथक् प्रकीर्णा मनुजै: प्रमर्दिता: ॥ २.९१.८३ ॥
transliteration: tathaiva mattā madirotkaṭā narāstathaiva divyāgurucandanokṣitā: ।tathaiva divyā vividhā: sraguttamā: pṛthak prakīrṇā manujai: pramarditā: ॥ 2.91.83 ॥

translations.english: Those rivers, the gandharvas and all those lovely women took leave of sage Bharadwaja and returned to where they had come from.
